keywords.en: A: He declined my call for some reason.
B: He probably hit the decline button by accident
keywords.ko: 아마 거절버튼을 실수로 누른 걸 거야
Probably:  꽤나 확신에 가까운 상태, 강한 추측  (Maybe는 확률이 50%정도 반반되서 여기에서는 사용하지 않는 게 좋음)
50%의 확률이라고 보고 (50%로 확률이니까 maybe를 사용하는 게 나음)

keywords.en: (Just in case), Why don’t you leave him a message just in case and wait for him to call you back
keywords.ko: 혹시 모르니까 문자를 남겨놓고 전화를 기다려봐

keywords.en: A: He declined my call for some reason.
B: He probably put the decline button by accident
Why don’t you leave him a message, just in case, and wait for him to call you back

my_sentences.ko: 1. For some reason (무슨 이유에서인지 / 왠지)

my_sentences.en: For some reason, the Wi-Fi isn't working at all today.
my_sentences.ko: 무슨 이유에서인지 오늘 와이파이가 전혀 안 돼.

my_sentences.en: She looked upset for some reason during the meeting.
my_sentences.ko: (그녀는 회의 중에 왠지 기분이 안 좋아 보였어.)

my_sentences.en: For some reason, I woke up really early this morning.
my_sentences.ko: (왠지 오늘 아침에는 눈이 일찍 떠졌어.)

my_sentences.en: My car won't start for some reason.
my_sentences.ko: (무슨 이유인지 차 시동이 안 걸려.)

my_sentences.en: For some reason, I can't find my car keys anywhere.
my_sentences.ko: (왜인지 차 키가 아무리 찾아도 안 보여.)
2. By accident (실수로 / 우연히)

my_sentences.en: I deleted the important file by accident.
my_sentences.ko: (중요한 파일을 실수로 지워버렸어.)

my_sentences.en: I ran into my middle school friend at the station by accident.
my_sentences.ko: (역에서 중학교 친구를 우연히 마주쳤어.)

my_sentences.en: He spilled hot coffee on his shirt by accident.
my_sentences.ko: (그는 실수로 셔츠에 뜨거운 커피를 쏟았어.)

my_sentences.en: I hung up the phone by accident.
my_sentences.ko: (실수로 전화를 끊어버렸어.)

my_sentences.en: She sent the message to the wrong group chat by accident.
my_sentences.ko: (그녀는 단체 채팅방에 실수로 메시지를 잘못 보냈어.)
3. Probably vs. Maybe vs. Could be (확률에 따른 추측)

my_sentences.en: He is probably still in a meeting; his calendar was full.
my_sentences.ko: [높은 확신] (그는 아마 아직 회의 중일 거야. 일정이 꽉 차 있었거든.)

my_sentences.en: Maybe it will rain this afternoon, so take an umbrella.
my_sentences.ko: [반반의 가능성] (오후에 비가 올 수도 있으니까 우산 챙겨.)
A: Do you think he forgot our dinner plan? B: Could be. (가벼운 동의/가능성)
(A: 걔 우리 저녁 약속 까먹은 걸까? B: 그럴 수도 있겠다.)

my_sentences.en: They will probably accept our offer.
my_sentences.ko: [높은 확신] (그쪽에서 아마 우리 제안을 받아들일 거야.)

my_sentences.en: Maybe she changed her mind.
my_sentences.ko: [반반의 가능성](어쩌면 그녀가 마음을 바꿨을지도 몰라.)
4. Just in case (혹시 모르니까 / 만약을 대비해서)

my_sentences.en: Take an umbrella just in case.
my_sentences.ko: (혹시 모르니까 우산 챙겨.)

my_sentences.en: Keep a copy of your passport just in case.
my_sentences.ko: (만약을 대비해 여권 사본 하나 챙겨 둬.)

my_sentences.en: I wrote down her phone number just in case my phone dies.
my_sentences.ko: (핸드폰 배터리가 나갈 때를 대비해서 그녀 번호를 적어 뒀어.)

my_sentences.en: Let's buy some extra water just in case.
my_sentences.ko: (혹시 모르니까 물을 좀 더 사두자.)

my_sentences.en: Just in case you need my help, give me a call.
my_sentences.ko: (혹시 도움이 필요하면 전화해.)

my_sentences.en: A: John hasn't replied to my email yet for some reason.
my_sentences.ko: (존이 무슨 이유에서인지 아직 내 메일에 답장을 안 해.)

my_sentences.en: B: He probably missed it because he receives tons of emails every day.
my_sentences.ko: (매일 메일이 엄청 오니까 아마 못 보고 지나쳤을 거야.)

my_sentences.en: A: Maybe he's out of the office today?
my_sentences.ko: (혹시 오늘 외근 나간 건가?)

my_sentences.en: B: Could be. Why don't you send him a quick message on Slack just in case?
my_sentences.ko: (그럴 수도 있겠다. 혹시 모르니까 슬랙으로 간단히 메시지 남겨보는 건 어때?)
상황 2: 약속 장소에 친구가 늦을 때

my_sentences.en: A: Mike is not picking up his phone for some reason.
my_sentences.ko: (마이크가 왜인지 전화를 안 받네.)

my_sentences.en: B: He probably put his phone on silent by accident.
my_sentences.ko: (실수로 폰을 무음으로 해뒀을 가능성이 높아.)

my_sentences.en: A: Maybe he got stuck in traffic.
my_sentences.ko: (어쩌면 차가 막혀서 그런 걸지도 몰라.)

my_sentences.en: B: Could be. Let's wait inside the cafe just in case it gets colder.
my_sentences.ko: (그럴 수도 있지. 더 추워질 수도 있으니까 카페 들어가서 기다리자.)
